user.title: Native TV overlay sender
user.description: The native SmittyOv01.overlay TV app must already be installed. Enter HA's directly reachable plain HTTP LAN address/port, not an external HTTPS proxy. Optional receiver launch never wakes the TV and remains off by default pending TV verification.

data.local_ip: HA LAN IPv4 address (UDP source and image URL)
data.ensure_receiver: Launch the receiver only if the TV reports on (experimental, default off)

error.invalid_address: Use literal private IPv4 addresses and valid ports.

abort.already_configured: Only one native TV sender is supported. Remove the existing entry before configuring another.
